fit: The official journal scope includes theoretical quantum information research and explicitly names entanglement and discord; this manuscript gives a self-contained analytic entanglement-of-purification result with a precisely restricted fixed-split, pathwise scope.
ai_policy_summary: Springer Nature uses a risk-based AI policy requiring transparent disclosure, accuracy checks, human oversight, and author accountability; it does not permit AI to replace authorship or generate scholarly claims or interpretations without adequate oversight. This project used AI beyond language editing, while human scientific verification is still pending.
